_doc: Signal masts and signal posts on the lap corridor, and the count at every junction OSM tags as signalled (PLAN 4b). signal_mast: a pole with an arm over the roadway (signal heads hang from it); signal_post: any pole or pedestal carrying signal or pedestrian heads with no arm over the road, tall or short; carries_lamp is true where it also carries a light (its eye note names one, or its shadow is 5 m or longer). Classes are the eye's, off the aerial. Heads, their number and their faces are not read. See SURVEY.md.
